# Templates

A Template is a venue's setup, saved on this iPhone or iPad. Starting a Show from it readies the room in one tap. Templates are part of [Pro](/docs/pricing) and the 14-day Trial.

## What a Template saves

- **Channel names** you typed for each USB Channel.
- **The mixer**, by its network name, so the Template finds it again even when its address changes.
- **The Show name.** The Template's name is also the Show's: a Template called "Sunday Service" starts a Show named with the date and "Sunday Service".
- **Pre-roll** length.
- **Which USB Channels are armed**, when some are not. See [Choosing which channels record](/docs/arming-channels).
- **Venue**, when the Template was saved from a past Show.

A Template doesn't save the Drive folder.

## Save the current setup

1. Tap the Show line above the Record button to open the **Show** sheet.
2. Under **Templates**, tap **Save this setup as a Template…**.
3. Type a name and tap **Save**.

## Save a past Show as a Template

1. Tap **Shows**, then tap the Show.
2. Tap **Save as Template…**, type a name and tap **Save**.

This keeps that Show's channel names and venue, with today's Pre-roll and mixer.

## Start a Show from a Template

Open the **Show** sheet and tap the Template. ShowRecorder ends the open Show, starts a new one and brings in the Template's channel names, Pre-roll, mixer and the USB Channels it arms (with the Audio interface Ready).

A Template can't be used during a Take.

## Make a Template the default

Tap the star next to a Template. The default Template readies the next Show when the app opens with no Show open. Tap the filled star again to stop using it as the default.

## Rename or delete

Swipe a Template, or touch and hold it, for **Rename**, **Delete** and **Make default**.

## After the Trial

On Free, your saved Templates are kept and still listed, but can't be used until you buy Pro. Nothing you saved is deleted.
